title: Magistrate heavy pistol
paint:
A steel single-action heavy service pistol of the century-old pattern. Pose: side profile turned slightly toward the viewer, muzzle right, level, filling about 80% of the canvas width. Silhouette, kept exactly: a slim, full-length flat-sided steel slide with vertical serrations at the rear; a short round barrel bushing at the muzzle, flush with the slide (no flare); a spur hammer at the back; a grip safety in the back of the grip with a beavertail; a thumb safety lever above the grip; a straight, near-vertical grip with flat side panels; a slim rounded trigger guard and a long flat trigger. Materials: polished dark blued steel with worn bright edges. Maker's touch: ivory grip panels with one small blank brass seal plate set in them.
At 32 px: a long slim flat slide over a straight grip with pale panels.
